resources.string: What would you like to secure?
TrueVault only ever sees the files you pick.

Photos come from the Android photo picker and documents from the system file picker, so TrueVault never asks for access to all your files. If you decline a picker, nothing happens and nothing is imported.
TrueVault needs %1$s more free space. Nothing has been encrypted, and nothing has been changed.
